subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the Microsoft Teams plugin recover channel/group attachments by broadening the existing Graph fallback by default, or should this remain behind an explicit opt-in config path?
rationale: The bug is real and documented, but the active candidate fixes choose different product surfaces for Graph lookups on Teams HTML stubs, and that tradeoff affects existing operator expectations and message delivery behavior.

options.title: Land the broader plugin fix
options.body: Accept the proof-sufficient no-new-config fix path that keeps the repair inside the Microsoft Teams plugin and covers channel top-level plus thread replies.

options.title: Require opt-in config
options.body: Prefer a default-off setting for extra Graph fetches, with docs and tests that clearly scope what channel or group-chat behavior it covers.

options.title: Pause for more live variants
options.body: Hold both candidate PRs until maintainers get exact-head live proof for more Teams channel, group-chat, private-channel, or permission-denied cases.

recommendation.title: Land the broader plugin fix
recommendation.body: Accept the proof-sufficient no-new-config fix path that keeps the repair inside the Microsoft Teams plugin and covers channel top-level plus thread replies.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a plugin-boundary and config-surface policy choice, and history shows the strongest current routing signal on the central Teams plugin files.
